■ Stage Direction
Uma Magical Girl = Umajokko

★ Request
Attire: Casual Clothes

■ Stage Direction
Age: 5
Personality: Shy

■ Stage Direction
Saying "Good girl, good girl" while gently patting her on the head.

■ Stage Direction
Whimpering anxiously

I took a handkerchief from my pocket
and gently wiped away the little girl's tears.

There, all clean now. Isn't that better?
So... were you out shopping today?

...The Uma Magical Girl... transformation wand...
Mommy and Daddy... said they'd buy it for me...

She was curled up crying all by herself in the corner,
so I tried talking to her, but...

Trainer! Perfect timing.
I think this little girl might be lost.

The little girl gave another small nod. It seemed she really was lost.
At a time like this, what could I do...?

On a rare day off,
I went to the shopping mall to pick up some daily necessities, when—

There weren't any store staff or anyone nearby to help.
To be honest... I was really at a loss for what to do.

Even so... because you were with me, Trainer,
I felt so relieved.

Trainer...!
.
*Waaaah*, *waaaaah*!

You were wonderful today, Trainer.
Don't say you weren't helpful, because you really were.
I see~. Was there something you wanted?

It's not a good idea to lead a lost child around on our own,
so I thought about calling for help, but...

It seemed our dynamic wouldn't be changing just yet.
However, it was a day that proved just how much trust Super Creek placed in me.
*Hic*, *hic*...

Ah...
I'll wait here with her, then.
The little girl gave a small nod...

I just made the girl cry right when she was starting to calm down...!
Large teardrops spilled down her cheeks.

That's lovely~, you must have been so excited.
So, did you come shopping with Mommy and Daddy?

Besides... you've learned to bring your handkerchief properly now too.
Good boy/girl, good boy/girl♪
*Sniff*... *sob*...
*Sob*... *hic*... I don't know... *waaaaah*!

There, there, being all alone was scary, wasn't it?
Shh, it's okay~.

Not at all, having you here was a huge help, Trainer.
Be proud of yourself.

You rushed over right at that moment...
I was truly so happy back then.

Upon arriving at the lost child center, there stood a couple looking pale and frantic.
It seemed they were the little girl's parents...!

Fufu, it looks like I need to study up
on what goes on in a child's heart.
Hold on just a moment. Right now... hmmm...
Oh my, you could tell? Ufufu♪
Of course!
(...You really were so dependable, Trainer.)

There, there, you were feeling so anxious, weren't you?
Don't worry, everything is going to be alright now.

Thank you so much for today, Trainer.
I'm so glad that little one was reunited with their parents...
